input.free_text_description: This system is a social platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for alpha, comment, data. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a User, I want to interact with alpha functionality, so that I can accomplish my alpha-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with comment functionality, so that I can accomplish my comment-related tasks.
